svg.aria-label: Memory tiers of a multi core CPU with stalling instruction pointers and a remote NUMA read
svg.title: Memory tiers of a multi core CPU with stalling instruction pointers and a remote NUMA read
svg.desc: Four cores, each with a three instruction stream and a moving instruction pointer that holds on its load until the data arrives. Below them sit registers, private L1 and L2, a shared L3 per NUMA node, per node DRAM and a shared NVMe SSD. Four fetches climb in parallel and shrink from a 4 KiB page to a 128 byte sector in L3 and L2, then a 64 byte line in L1, then an 8 byte word. Core 2 reads memory owned by node 0, so its block crosses the cross node link before it can start climbing.
svg.text: non volatile, shared by both nodes
core 2's page lives on node 0, so it crosses the link before climbing
each ip stalls on its load until the word lands, then moves on
